rationale: A finite passive offer whose expiry is before now never opens.
Expiry is evaluated before identity matching when nowMs equals expiresAtMs, so an expired matching offer is never retained.
A live passive offer opens only when gameplay is not in combat and no screen is active.
Matching derives from equal non-empty request/current identities.
First blocked observation defers the authoritative offer and requests one caller-owned notification.
The same already-notified identity remains deferred without another notification.
Another screen defers the offer until currentScreen becomes null and notifies once.
Repeated observation of the same blocked identity is silent.
A new caller-owned identity resets notification eligibility.
A passive social offer never displaces a system terminal.
An immediate user keypress may open when no screen blocks it.
A matching screen is not recreated.
An ordinary nonmatching screen consumes the physical moment; the keypress is not queued.
Physical keypresses are never queued for future replay behind a modal.
A hotkey never displaces or waits behind a system terminal.
An expired insight settles through its domain owner and never opens.
A live insight opens when no UI is active.
Insight may replace ordinary non-modal UI through transition arbitration.
The same insight identity is not reopened.
Insight waits behind an equal or higher modal and notifies once.
Repeated blocked insight observation is silent.
Insight never displaces death or termination UI.
A death terminal opens when no screen is active.
The same terminal identity is not recreated.
Death may displace lower-priority ordinary UI.
Death may displace lower-priority modal UI.
Terminate explicitly outranks Death.
Death cannot preempt a visible Terminate terminal.
A nonmatching equal-priority terminal is not replaced.
A nonmatching Terminate terminal cannot replace an equal-priority peer.
